items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The professor who conducted us and traveled with us, and it was his car, was partly blind.

ctx.x: You say you learned a lot from her

. . . the women I’ve know in my life. But down South, I got very angry at just – I said, if I get out of here, I’m never coming back. With the Wilberforce Singers, we had to drive pretty far to get out of – where were we? I think we were in Georgia. We – there were six of us in the car, singers: one woman who came from Canada, another woman who came from someplace else. We were driving along. There was a kind of stop sign in the middle of the road. There are these guys, chain gang, chained together. The professor…
What! They shot at you! The sheriffs, the people.
